steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Facts: Lagos is a megacity in Nigeria, West Africa. It is built on the coast of the Gulf of Guinea and on islands in Lagos Lagoon. With a population of approximately 15 million (metropolitan area), it is the largest city in sub-Saharan Africa and Nigeria's economic capital. Lagos grows by an estimated 77 people per hour. | Key Fact: Lagos was a small town of approximately 300,000 in 1950. By 2025, the metropolitan population is approximately 15 million - a 50-fold increase in 75 years. Projections suggest it could reach 25 million by 2035. | Exam Tip: When assessing urban planning, always evaluate whether strategies benefit ALL residents or just the wealthy.
